WHERE valve:BallValve OR valve:CheckValve OR valve:GlobeValve OR valve:OperatedValve
RETURN DISTINCT valve.tag AS tag
ORDER BY tag
LIMIT 1000

MATCH (source:PlantItem {unit_id: '38'})-[:send_to]->(destination:PlantItem)
WHERE destination.unit_id IS NOT NULL AND destination.unit_id <> '38'
RETURN DISTINCT destination.unit_id AS unit_id

MATCH (source:PlantItem)-[:send_to]->(target:PlantItem)
WHERE toString(source.unit_id) = '4'
  AND target.unit_id IS NOT NULL
  AND toString(target.unit_id) <> '4'
RETURN DISTINCT target.unit_id AS other_unit, target.tag AS tag
ORDER BY other_unit, tag;

MATCH (source:PlantItem)-[:send_to]->(destination:PlantItem)
WHERE source.unit_id = '3'
  AND destination.unit_id IS NOT NULL
  AND destination.unit_id <> source.unit_id
RETURN DISTINCT destination.unit_id AS other_unit, destination.tag AS tag

MATCH (source:PlantItem {unit_id: '45'})-[:send_to]->(target:PlantItem)
WHERE target.unit_id IS NOT NULL AND target.unit_id <> source.unit_id
RETURN DISTINCT source.tag AS source_tag, target.unit_id AS destination_unit, target.tag AS destination_tag
ORDER BY destination_unit, source_tag, destination_tag;

MATCH (source:PlantItem)-[:send_to]->(target:PlantItem)
WHERE source.unit_id = '31'
  AND target.unit_id IS NOT NULL
  AND target.unit_id <> source.unit_id
RETURN target.unit_id AS unit_id, collect(DISTINCT target.tag) AS tags
ORDER BY unit_id

MATCH (source:PlantItem {unit_id: "15"})-[:send_to]->(destination:PlantItem)
WHERE destination.unit_id IS NOT NULL AND destination.unit_id <> source.unit_id
RETURN DISTINCT destination.unit_id AS unit_id, destination.tag AS tag
ORDER BY unit_id, tag;

MATCH (source:PlantItem {unit_id: "37"})-[:send_to]->(destination:PlantItem)
WHERE destination.unit_id IS NOT NULL AND destination.unit_id <> source.unit_id
RETURN DISTINCT destination.unit_id AS unit_id
ORDER BY unit_id

MATCH (source:PlantItem {unit_id: "24"})-[:send_to]->(target:PlantItem)
WHERE target.unit_id IS NOT NULL AND target.unit_id <> source.unit_id
RETURN DISTINCT target.unit_id AS unit_id, target.tag AS tag
ORDER BY unit_id, tag;

MATCH (source:PlantItem {unit_id: '2'})-[:send_to]->(target:PlantItem)
WHERE target.unit_id IS NOT NULL AND target.unit_id <> '2'
RETURN DISTINCT target.unit_id AS unit_id, target.tag AS tag
ORDER BY unit_id, tag
LIMIT 1000

MATCH (source:PlantItem {unit_id: "35"})-[:send_to]->(target:PlantItem)
WHERE target.unit_id IS NOT NULL AND target.unit_id <> source.unit_id
RETURN DISTINCT target.unit_id AS unit_id, target.tag AS tag

MATCH (valve:PlantItem:BallValve)
WHERE toString(valve.unit_id) = '33'
RETURN valve.tag AS tag

MATCH (v:PlantItem:GlobeValve)
WHERE v.unit_id = '8'
RETURN v.tag AS tag
ORDER BY tag

MATCH (v:GlobeValve)
WHERE v.unit_id = '1'
RETURN v.tag AS tag

MATCH (p:PlantItem:CentrifugalPump)
WHERE p.unit_id = '52'
RETURN p.tag AS tag
ORDER BY tag

MATCH (p:PlantItem:CentrifugalPump)
WHERE p.unit_id = '44'
RETURN collect(p.tag) AS tags, count(p.tag) AS number of_pumps

MATCH (column:ProcessColumn)
WHERE toString(column.unit_id) = '20'
RETURN count(column) AS number_of_process_columns

MATCH (p:PlantItem:CentrifugalPump)
WHERE p.unit_id = '8'
RETURN count(p) AS number_of_centrifugal_pumps, collect(p.tag) AS tags

MATCH (p:ProcessColumn)
WHERE p.unit_id = "36" AND p.tag IS NOT NULL
RETURN count(DISTINCT p.tag) AS number of process columns in unit 36?

MATCH (t:Tank:PlantItem)
WHERE t.unit_id = 37
RETURN count(t.tag) AS number_of_tanks

MATCH (item:PlantItem {tag: "V-40-3"})-[:is_drawn_on]->(sheet:Sheet)
RETURN DISTINCT item.tag AS tag, sheet.sheet_id AS sheet_id

MATCH (item:PlantItem {tag: "T-41-1"})-[:is_drawn_on]->(sheet:Sheet)
RETURN DISTINCT item.tag AS tag, sheet.sheet_id AS sheet_id

MATCH (item:PlantItem {tag: "P-11-3"})-[:is_drawn_on]->(sheet:Sheet)
RETURN DISTINCT item.tag AS tag, sheet.sheet_id AS sheet_id
ORDER BY sheet_id
